name: Embracing the Elements
summary: In Thendal Grove, Rorian the Dayseeker calls young shamans to begin their elemental training. Windshaper Boro’s message speaks of a silence between the people and the spirits of the winds.

sections.title: A Summons to the Elements
sections.body: Rorian the Dayseeker comes to you after you help with the vuldren around the village. Windshaper Boro left a humming recall crystal while you were away. Its message calls you to the center of the grove, where formal elemental instruction begins.

sections.title: The Silent Winds
sections.body: Windshaper Boro tells you the spirits of the four winds ended all communication years ago. They left behind the communion they once shared with the people. Now the shamans of Zephras study the natural world and train hard, hoping to bridge the silence and speak with the spirits again.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Embracing the Elements?
faq.answer: After you help with the local vuldren problem, Rorian the Dayseeker sends you from Thendal Grove on Zephras Isle.
Near the center of Thendal Grove on Zephras Isle, Windshaper Boro trains the settlement’s shamans.

faq.q: Why did the elemental spirits stop speaking to the people here?
aliases: spirits of the four winds silent
what happened to the wind spirits
faq.answer: Windshaper Boro says the spirits of the four winds stopped speaking and left the people years ago. The local shamans do not know why, but they study in hope of restoring that bond.

faq.q: What is the Humming Recall Crystal?
faq.answer: Windshaper Boro left the humming recall crystal while you were away helping the settlement. Examining it signals that you are ready to begin elemental training under his guidance.

faq.q: What prerequisite quest leads to Embracing the Elements?
aliases: what comes before embracing the elements
faq.answer: Harmony in Balance comes first. You deal with the vuldren disrupting the surrounding area.

faq.q: What role does Windshaper Boro play in Thendal Grove?
faq.answer: Windshaper Boro trains the shamans of Thendal Grove. He teaches new initiates about elemental communion and the natural world.

angles.text: As a shaman, you meet Windshaper Boro for formal instruction and learn that the elemental winds have fallen silent. Shamans devote themselves to restoring communion with them.
As a Horde traveler on Zephras Isle, you encounter the island’s elemental callers and their struggle with the spirits. The spirits’ silence shapes their training.
